title: Blood-Washed Dao Diagram
summary: The tribulation isn't over: an Innate Dao Diagram, the will of heaven and earth itself, descends to erase the Holy Body. Ye Fan fights it with the Chaos Green Lotus, Yin-Yang and Immortal King visions, but his power drains away. Jiang Taixu steps in, swinging the Hengyu Divine Furnace against the diagram, and despite Ye Fan's protests he spends his own divine blood, which can cleanse karma and light up the Dao. The blood purifies the diagram and reforges the broken road of the Holy Body, but it leaves Taixu 'at the sunset of his life'. Ye Fan finishes the karma with a last strike as a Divine Symphony sounds. Challengers from Zhongzhou come at once: Ye Fan defeats Gu Mingdao (Four Poles, perfected) and a challenger in Holy Lord-grade battle armour. He sends one back to Zhongzhou with the message that he will face anyone.
events: Ye Fan resists with his visions and the Chaos Green Lotus

cultivation: Ye Fan completes his Four Poles breakthrough. The Dao Diagram 'aims to destroy your Dao foundation' rather than kill him (10:57), which sets up the Dao wound. Caption: Gu Mingdao, Four Poles (perfected).
